description:
A medical student is building a cranial anatomy teaching atlas and needs reference images of the CT Cranium dataset from all three orthogonal viewing planes, each navigated to approximately the level of the sella turcica.

The CT Cranium dataset is already loaded in InVesalius. Your task is to navigate each orthogonal slice view to approximately the sella turcica level and export each as a separate PNG image:

1. Navigate the AXIAL view to approximately the skull base level (around slice 30-50 out of 108) where the sella turcica region is visible, and export the view as: /home/ga/Documents/axial_sella.png

2. Navigate the SAGITTAL view to approximately the midline of the skull (center left-right) where the sella turcica is visible in profile, and export the view as: /home/ga/Documents/sagittal_sella.png

3. Navigate the CORONAL view to approximately the middle of the anteroposterior range where the sella turcica cross-section is visible, and export the view as: /home/ga/Documents/coronal_sella.png

The sella turcica is a saddle-shaped depression in the sphenoid bone at the base of the skull, roughly at the center of the head in all three dimensions.

All three output files must be valid PNG images, each showing a different orthogonal plane of the cranial CT. You may use any export method available in InVesalius (File > Export Picture, right-click export, or other approaches).
